Interface Validator

All Known Implementing Classes:
CoreContextOrderValidator, CoreV2Validator
public interface Validator
A pluggable info.json validator, analogous to ImageSource and TileSink.

Implementations live in core (generic IIIF rules) and in the extension modules (e.g. C2PA, UltraHDR service semantics) and are discovered via ServiceLoader (register with @AutoService(Validator.class)). The InfoJsonValidator facade runs JSON Schema validation first and then every discovered validator whose supports(ImageInfo.IIIFVersion) accepts the effective version, merging all ValidationResults.

Contract: validators must be stateless and thread-safe and must only report findings for documents they understand (return ValidationResult.ok(ImageInfo.IIIFVersion) otherwise); invocation order is unspecified.
